name: Polanco Kitchen & Bar
notes: 4 photos, all menu boards/pages. Photo 1 is a multi-panel printed menu (appetizer/late-night, kids, breakfast, lunch, dinner, beverages, sweets); photos 2-3 are the same standalone laminated dinner menu shot twice (merged, not duplicated) and add several house specialties not on photo 1's dinner panel; photo 4 is a wine/tequila list only, skipped per drink-only rule. Overlapping items (salads, soup, fries, wings, burger) appearing on multiple panels/photos were merged into one entry.
